Build notes and screenshot details

Private testing, not a public release

This is the introduction website for spool for Android. No public visitor APK has been selected or published here. There is no working download on this page. Real-device keyboard, playback and provider acceptance are still pending.

What the screenshots show

The owner supplied these real-phone captures for this website. The full-player image excludes the device status bar and bottom system gesture area. The matching light and dark Explore details exclude the header profile, device status and lower controls. App pixels and artwork have not been redrawn, retouched or replaced. These captures show one device and session, not guaranteed catalogue or service availability.

Source and credits

spool is based on BitChord. The existing GPL v3 license, upstream authorship and third-party notices remain. A future APK download must include source matching that distributed build.
